summary: One-frame event of esv::sight::ViewshedSystem (CollectViewshedsWhereAParticipantUpdated / UpdateViewshedParticipantComponents read it). Seen whenever characters enter viewsheds: spawns, spells, dialogues.

fields.name: field_0
fields.evidence: Creator bg3.exe+0x2E64010 (AllocRaw 0x38) zeroes the 2 bytes at +0. The writer bg3.exe+0x2E5D940 (esv::sight::ViewshedSystem, per-entity 0x38-byte values of a local HashMap<EntityHandle, ...>) sets value byte 0 to 1 through the get-or-add bg3.exe+0x2E61B40 after walking an entity's added/removed participant list, and copies it with a byte store (*dst = *src) into the component. Live 0 or 1.

fields.name: field_1
fields.evidence: Same writer sets value byte 1 to 1 when the entry is created for an entity checked for esv::sight::ViewshedParticipantComponent (FUN_1440103b0 with its type index) and copies it as a separate byte (dst[1] = src[1]). Live always 0.

fields.name: _Pad2
fields.evidence: not written by the creator nor copied by the writer; live garbage.

fields.name: Participants
fields.evidence: Creator zeroes a HashSet at +8..+0x38 (bucket ptr/count, NextIds +0x18, Keys +0x28 with size +0x34); destructor LAB_1406b4cb0. Writer bg3.exe+0x2E5D940 copies the local value's set with the HashSet copy bg3.exe+0x5DF700 and fills it with bg3.exe+0x721030 (find/insert comparing 8-byte keys at Keys + i*8) using the entity of each 0x20-byte change entry whose flag byte +8 is 0 (added; flag 1 = removed goes elsewhere). Live: up to 0x1D keys.

open_questions: Meaning (game names) of the two flag bytes at +0 and +1.
second_pass: Windows writer bg3.exe+0x2E5D940 (ViewshedSystem) copies byte +0, byte +1 and the HashSet at +8 separately and inserts 8-byte entity keys (bg3.exe+0x721030), which settles all boundaries and the key width; only the two flags remain unnamed.
